newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Wednesday amid low demand from spinners and dealers said prices might open unchanged on Thursday.
They said selective buying of quality stocks had helped prevent a fall in prices but overall the market was dull.
In the kerb market, MNH-93 variety was traded in the range of 2,110 rupees ($52.46) to 2,375 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
